integrity: Proof is analytic; exact finite enumeration is supplementary and not an infinite certificate. No outside audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Identical positive additive valuations with each good worth one or two units of a common positive scale; at least as many goods as agents and at least two agents. Bound is for every EF1 allocation, sharp as a worst-case ratio. Independent priority and proof review pending.
title: Sharp Nash-welfare guarantee of EF1 for two positive good values
